budget_items.topic: Stormwater compliance cost to the Town
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The new EPA stormwater permit requirements were described as creating an unknown cost and impact to the Town, and the Town will have to contract with an engineering firm; no dollar figure was printed.
budget_items.quote: this will create an unknown cost and impact to the town.

budget_items.topic: Stormwater utility enterprise account and fee
budget_items.what_was_recorded: A stormwater fee through a utility enterprise account was proposed, with funds used only for stormwater activities; creating the account requires Town Meeting vote. No amounts were printed.
budget_items.quote: a fee could be put in place through a stormwater utility enterprise account with those funds being used only for stormwater activities.

budget_items.topic: Anticipated annual cost to the Town
budget_items.what_was_recorded: T. Alonzo asked the anticipated annual cost to the Town; A. Burney described Auburn's GIS-based method, with the Town's portion in the General Budget. No amount was printed.
budget_items.quote: t. alonzo inquired as to anticipated annual cost to the town.
